byte_encoding_rule: In payload_literal the tokens <BOM>, <CR>, <LF> decode to U+FEFF, 0x0D and 0x0A; every other character is a UTF-8 literal. Named hashes are sha256 over the decoded bytes, frozen in fixtures.lock at fixture build time and never recomputed from implementation output.
